cityBuildings.prompt: Six isolated detailed medieval strategy buildings in equal 3x2 transparent cells: half-timbered house, thatched barn, timber workshop, mine hoist, forge, town treasury. Elevated three-quarter isometric camera, muted earth tones, subtle stone/wood/roof textures, clear silhouettes, soft upper-left daylight; no people, flags, platforms, text or scattered props. Rich craftsmanship without visual clutter.
